note: Offline behavioral eval. Run: cd evals && uv run python grade.py (exits non-zero on any failure). The fixture is a small real slice of skillData/polPolsetRole.json (generated 2026-10-18) plus one synthetic formula-injection policy; meta.json carries a fixed ancient fetch date so the staleness assertion is deterministic.

evals.name: status-provenance
evals.asserts: status returns provenance with per-entity counts

evals.name: staleness-loud
evals.asserts: --max-age-days flags an old snapshot as stale with a warning

evals.name: get-by-id-and-name
evals.asserts: exact lookup works by policyId and by policyName; list fields are arrays

evals.name: search-substring
evals.asserts: case-insensitive --where filters (booleans matched as text); pagination covers every row once

evals.name: rel-policy-initiatives-all
evals.asserts: REGRESSION: a policy in 15 initiatives returns 15 distinct refs (the CSV parse returned 1)

evals.name: role-arrays
evals.asserts: role action lists are arrays; an empty list stays []

evals.name: rel-role-policies
evals.asserts: >=2 refs with ids; REGRESSION: an unused role returns [] (the CSV parse returned one blank item)

evals.name: initiative-grouped
evals.asserts: initiative meta + member policies with names and per-reference effects; id lookup case-insensitive

evals.name: output-sanitization
evals.asserts: formula-injection cells (= + - @) prefixed with ' on output

evals.name: ingest-failsafe
evals.asserts: drift, version bump, non-JSON and row-floor refuse and keep existing cache; happy path writes atomically with sha, etag and counts; 304 keeps the file

evals.name: auto-refresh-stale
evals.asserts: a snapshot older than --max-age-days (default 7) auto-refreshes on read when not --offline

evals.name: no-refresh-fresh
evals.asserts: within the freshness window no network is touched
